text_block_list.text:
With the Sprinters Stakes looming just 
ahead— the deadline day for race entry 
registration.

When K.S.Miracle came to the trainer's 
office for our meeting, I braced myself 
and told her "something" regarding her 
next race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, ...excuse me. Could we do that one 
more time, please...?

I nod back at her confused look and slowly 
declare it once more.
choice_data_list: Let's withdraw from the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.text:
I listened to how K.S.Miracle felt. Even 
so, I tell her that I cannot simply 
overlook this.

"As the one entrusted with you by your 
parents and your doctor... 'And above all 
else, as the Trainer who guides you—'"
choice_data_list: I can't put you in any more danger.
I can't put you in danger any longer.

text_block_list.text:
"As the one entrusted with you by your 
parents and your doctor... 'And above all 
else, as the Trainer who guides you—'"
choice_data_list: I can't put you in any more danger.
I can't put you in danger any longer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Dangerous...? No way...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm running with full awareness of 
everything. ...And that's okay. I'll be 
fine."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, didn't I? Everything was 
given to me by everyone from the very 
start. My life, my body, my legs—all of it 
is mine because of them."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have to properly repay what I've 
received. That's why I'll use everything I 
have. I have to use it... to return the 
miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it means using up everything I 
have. Even if I get hurt... even if I 
break. That... that's how I want it."

"Of course it's not fine," I shot back 
immediately. To begin with, she claimed 
she was doing it 'to return the favor'— in 
other words, out of gratitude.

Her benefactors, who care so deeply for 
K.S.Miracle and worry about her day in and 
day out—
choice_data_list: I don't want you to repay me like that!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing this just because I was 
asked to!!

Her unprecedented fury rendered me 
speechless. ...K.S.Miracle continued in a 
trembling voice.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I know that everyone is kind. You too, 
Trainer. If I got hurt, I know you'd be 
sad."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know! No one will be happy about it! 
It's not what anyone wants!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, gh...――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, this is all I've got left.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To my mom and dad, who held my hand until 
dawn every night. To the doctor, who 
stayed by my side for days without going 
home—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You make all those training menus and so 
much delicious food, working so hard every 
single day to support me... This is for 
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aside from running, I don't know how else 
I could ever repay everyone.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've even been told that I don't need to 
do anything at all. That just staying 
healthy, just being alive, is more than 
enough.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: However, I don't see it that way.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm filled to the brim with miracles and 
treasures. Things given to me by my 
parents, my doctors, and teachers... and 
what was given to me by you."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I keep taking, keep holding onto it all, 
yet I have nothing of my own. To just live 
on without giving anything back—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I can't... do this...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Being told I don't have to do anything... 
Just simply existing... I don't want that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I... I just want to be like 
everyone else—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to become a life with meaning.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer. This is our only chance. 
It has to be "now"...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is repay it by running with 
these legs. The only thing worthy of the 
miracle I was given is the title of the 
fastest—a GⅠ victory!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be able to run for long anyway. 
Even the miracle everyone gave me is on 
the verge of running out...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, now that I can run the 
fastest, now that I can reach top speed! 
Even if I run myself to the limit, I have 
to get results!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So, right now! Right here, I'll reach the 
pinnacle of sprint!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I have to become the winner of the 
Sprinters Stakes!!"

K.S.Miracle flares up with emotion. Her 
cornered heart crashes straight into mine, 
making my chest feel like it's being 
crushed.
Even so. ...Even so, she shakes her head.
choice_data_list: I can't allow you to race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Then as I thought, just like we 
discussed at first.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please say that I decided everything. 
Please say that I'm the one who did it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The entry form is right there, isn't it? 
I'll go turn it in...!

I clung desperately to K.S. Miracle as she 
clutched the documents. I can't let her 
go. There's no way I'll let her, 
absolutely not!

Claiming that her life has no meaning 
unless she wins. Seeing her say something 
so heartbreaking—
choice_data_list:
(There's no way I can let them get away 
like this!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please let me go, Trainer!! Please let me 
go! I have to run!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have to run...!! Let go of me!! Let me 
go...!!

"Holding it back, bracing myself, ...ah, I 
realize."

"Under normal circumstances, it wouldn't 
have meant a thing. If she had truly gone 
wild, no amount of resistance on my part 
would have made a difference."

Because she's always been stronger than 
me. She could have pulled away, pushed me 
aside, or shoved me off— she had plenty of 
ways to break free.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let go of me... Trainer...

Even so, K.S.Miracle merely pleaded in a 
faint, delicate voice. Not once did she 
ever attempt to use force.

I'm sure she was trying not to hurt my 
feelings, even in the slightest.

She was so, so kind... and that kindness 
is what backed her into a corner. 
...That's why I couldn't bear to let her 
go even more.

In the end, time simply slipped away— and 
the race entry deadline closed.

K.S.Miracle has decided to withdraw from 
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, post time is drawing near for the GⅠ 
Sprinters Stakes! Which Umamusume will 
conquer this race and claim the title of 
the fastest?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With K.S.Miracle scratching from the race 
despite her rapidly rising acclaim as of 
late, there seems to be a widespread wave 
of disappointment—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"At this point, the question is who can 
escape Daiichi Ruby's closing burst. Let's 
keep our eyes glued to the track!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to see it through to the end. ...At 
least that much.

As KS Miracle answered in a voice barely 
above a whisper, we watched on together—

Post time for the Sprinters Stakes had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...An even, beautiful start.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(So many powerful footsteps. That scent 
when the dirt kicks up and the turf flies. 
The rumble of the cheers, my racing 
heartbeat.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Everything... is so distant, right now.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now heading from the 3rd to the 4th 
corner, finally into the final stretch!! 
The one breaking out of the pack is—”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everything is distant. It's all grown so 
far away. ...I can no longer...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Never again will I—

"The race is in its final phase. Just 
before the finish line. Amidst deafening 
cheers echoing through the speakers—"

Something lightly tapped against my 
shoulder.

For just the briefest moment, imparting 
the faintest trace of weight... K.S. 
Miracle's body gently slid down—
To the floor.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Up the slope, and she surges past in a 
flash! Daiichi Ruby takes the lead! 
Daiichi Ruby proves her sheer dominance 
once again!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is Daiichi Ruby, she crosses 
the finish line!! Daiichi Ruby, an 
overwhelming victory!!"

...And K.S.Miracle remained just like 
that.

No matter how many times I called out, how 
desperately I cried, she never opened her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Oh, how utter foolishness."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"A bird that brings happiness, you say? 
How utterly, utterly foolish."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Listen closely, foolish bird, the reason 
your body is blue is..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Made of nothing but simple glass, so 
fragile, fleeting, shattering into dust.’"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You can't carry anything. Not for 
everyone, and certainly not happiness."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "The blue bird."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "And so, just like that."
